csv_project_name: Design for Hobart Regional (HBR) Airport Rehab Runway 17/35
csv_scope_of_work: The Oklahoma Department of Aerospace & Aeronautics may be seeking a consultant to provide a Design for Hobart Regional (HBR) Airport Rehab Runway 17/35. The Overall Development Objective (ODO) of the proposed project is to rehabilitate Runway 17/35. The existing runway pavement is exhibiting seasonal environmental distresses such as weathering, raveling, and longitudinal/transverse cracking. The pavement is at a point where it is more cost effective to rehabilitate than let it deteriorate until a point where reconstruction is required. Rehabilitation will include a mill and overlay and will also address the non-standard connector taxiway on the south end.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
